categories.name: Positions
categories.blurb: The alphabet of ballet: where the feet live.

categories.name: Port de bras
categories.blurb: Carriage of the arms, head and upper body.

categories.name: Barre
categories.blurb: Warm-up vocabulary built at the barre.

categories.name: Centre & Adagio
categories.blurb: Slow, sustained balance and line in the centre.

categories.name: Grand allegro
categories.blurb: Big travelling leaps that cover the floor.

categories.name: Linking steps
categories.blurb: Steps that connect, travel and breathe.

categories.name: Pointe
categories.blurb: Vocabulary on the tips of the toes.

movements.name: Première position
movements.description: Heels together, legs rotated out from the hips so the feet form a wide, even line.
cues: Rotate from the top of the thigh, not the knees
Weight over the balls of the feet

movements.name: Seconde position
movements.description: Feet turned out and apart, about one and a half foot-lengths between the heels.

movements.name: Troisième position
movements.description: The heel of the front foot sits against the middle of the back foot — the gentle step towards fifth.
cues: Cross only as far as your rotation allows

movements.name: Quatrième position
movements.description: One foot in front of the other, a foot's length apart, both turned out — the classic pirouette preparation.

movements.name: Cinquième position
movements.description: Feet fully crossed, heel of the front foot to the toe of the back. The home of classical ballet.
cues: Front heel forward, back heel back

movements.name: Position parallèle
movements.description: Feet side by side, pointing forward. Common in warm-ups and contemporary-leaning classes.

movements.name: Sur le cou-de-pied
movements.english: On the neck of the foot
movements.description: The working foot wraps the supporting ankle, front or back — the starting point of frappés and petits battements.

movements.name: Retiré
movements.description: The working toe draws up the leg to touch just below the knee, thigh rotated out to the side.
cues: Knee to the side, not forward

movements.name: Bras bas
movements.description: Arms rounded and low in front of the thighs, fingertips almost touching — the resting position.
cues: Soft elbows, not touching the body

movements.name: Première position des bras
movements.description: Arms rounded in front of the body at the height of the lower ribs, as though holding a large ball.
cues: Hands in line with the sternum

movements.name: Seconde position des bras
movements.description: Arms open to the sides, slightly in front of the shoulders and gently sloping down.

movements.name: Troisième position des bras
movements.description: One arm in first, the other open to second — a frame for épaulement.
cues: Open arm supported from the back
Head can incline towards the front arm

movements.name: Quatrième position des bras
movements.description: One arm raised in fifth above the head while the other stays open in second.

movements.name: Cinquième position des bras
movements.english: Fifth position of the arms (en haut)
movements.description: Both arms raised in an oval just in front of and above the head.
cues: See your hands without lifting the chin

movements.name: Allongé
movements.description: The arms lengthen and the palms turn down, extending the line to the fingertips — often finishing an arabesque.

movements.name: Port de bras en avant
movements.description: The body folds forward from the hips, the arm following, then rolls up through the spine.
cues: Hinge from the hips, long back first
Head is the last to arrive
Keep weight forward over the feet

movements.name: Cambré en arrière
movements.description: The upper back arches backwards with the arm overhead, lifting up before going back.
cues: Keep the hips over the feet
Neck is a continuation of the spine

movements.name: Cambré de côté
movements.description: A lateral bend of the upper body, arm overhead, keeping both hips firmly down.
cues: Ribs open on the long side

movements.name: Épaulement
movements.description: A gentle spiral of the shoulders and head relative to the hips, giving three-dimensional life to every pose.
cues: Head inclines towards the front shoulder

movements.name: Révérence
movements.description: The graceful thank-you at the end of class: step, extend the back leg and bow with open arms.

movements.name: Demi-plié
movements.description: A half bend of the knees with the heels firmly down, knees opening directly over the toes.
cues: Heels stay glued to the floor
Equal down and up, always lengthening

movements.name: Grand plié
movements.description: A deep bend continuing past demi-plié; the heels release in first, fourth and fifth (never in second).
cues: Pass through demi-plié on the way down and up
Heels return to the floor as early as possible

movements.name: Grand plié en seconde
movements.description: In second position the heels never leave the floor; the thighs stop just above knee height.
cues: Knees push back over the toes
Sit 'between' the legs, not behind them

movements.name: Battement tendu
movements.description: The working foot slides out along the floor until only the tips of the toes touch, then draws back to fifth.
cues: Heel leads out, toes lead in
Never lose contact with the floor

movements.name: Tendu with demi-plié
movements.description: The foot extends to tendu, lowers the heel into fourth or second in demi-plié, then stretches back.

movements.name: Battement dégagé
movements.description: A quick tendu that brushes through and releases the foot about 25° off the floor.
cues: Accent out or in as the teacher asks

movements.name: Battement piqué
movements.description: From dégagé the pointed toe taps the floor lightly and rebounds, like a needle.
cues: Toe touches and lifts in the same breath

movements.name: Rond de jambe à terre
movements.english: Circle of the leg on the ground
movements.description: The pointed foot traces a half-circle on the floor: front, side, back, and closes through first.
cues: Rotation increases as the leg travels back
Trace a perfect 'D' on the floor

movements.name: Battement fondu
movements.description: Both knees bend together as the working foot sits sur le cou-de-pied, then both legs stretch together as it unfolds.
cues: Both legs bend and straighten at the same speed
Keep the knee of the working leg open

movements.name: Battement frappé
movements.description: From a flexed cou-de-pied the foot strikes out, brushing the floor, to a sharply pointed low extension.

movements.name: Double frappé
movements.description: Before striking, the foot beats front and back of the supporting ankle.

movements.name: Petit battement sur le cou-de-pied
movements.description: Rapid small beats of the working foot alternating in front and behind the supporting ankle.
cues: Move only from the knee down

movements.name: Rond de jambe en l'air
movements.english: Circle of the leg in the air
movements.description: With the thigh held à la seconde, the lower leg traces small ovals from the knee.
cues: Oval goes in to the calf and out to the extension

movements.name: Développé
movements.description: The working foot draws up through retiré and unfolds the leg slowly to its full height.
cues: Hold the thigh, unfold the lower leg
Lengthen the leg away as it rises

movements.name: Enveloppé
movements.description: The reverse of développé: the extended leg folds in to retiré and closes.
cues: Thigh holds as the lower leg folds
Arrive at the knee before closing

movements.name: Grand battement
movements.description: The straight leg is thrown high through tendu and lowered with control.
cues: Up with energy, down with control

movements.name: Battement en cloche
movements.description: A grand battement that swings like a bell from front to back through first position.

movements.name: Relevé
movements.description: Rising onto demi-pointe (or pointe), often springing in from a demi-plié.

movements.name: Élevé
movements.description: Rising to demi-pointe with straight knees — pure foot and calf strength.
cues: Rise through all of the foot

movements.name: Sous-sus
movements.description: A relevé into a tight fifth position, the legs so crossed they look like one.
cues: Pull the feet under the centre
Tall and still at the top

movements.name: Battement soutenu
movements.description: The supporting leg bends while the working leg extends; both draw together into relevé in fifth.
cues: Pull the legs together like a zip

movements.name: Flic-flac
movements.description: The working foot brushes in and out past the supporting ankle, closing and opening like a whip.
cues: Ball of the foot brushes the floor

movements.name: Battement battu
movements.description: Fast beats of the working foot against the front or back of the supporting ankle, on demi-pointe.
cues: Stay up on the supporting foot

movements.name: Passé relevé
movements.description: From fifth, the working foot travels up to retiré as the supporting leg rises to relevé.
cues: Arrive at the knee and the relevé together
Close with control to fifth back
Balance over the ball of the foot

movements.name: Stretch at the barre
movements.description: The leg rests on the barre while the body folds over it and then side bends, lengthening the hamstrings.
cues: Breathe into the stretch, never bounce

movements.name: Première arabesque
movements.description: Standing on one leg, the other extended straight behind; the arm on the supporting side reaches forward.
cues: Rotate and lengthen the back leg
Lift the chest, let the back curve naturally
Front arm in line with the eye

movements.name: Deuxième arabesque
movements.description: As first arabesque, but the opposite arm reaches forward, giving a spiral through the shoulders.

movements.name: Arabesque penchée
movements.description: From arabesque the body tips forward as the leg rises, like a see-saw, keeping the line from fingertips to toes.
cues: Leg rises as the body lowers
Keep the hips open but level

movements.name: Arabesque relevée
movements.description: Arabesque taken up onto demi-pointe or pointe, usually from a demi-plié.
cues: Don't let the leg drop as you rise
Lift out of the supporting hip

movements.name: Attitude derrière
movements.description: The leg lifts behind with the knee bent at about 90°, knee higher than the foot, arm raised in fifth.
cues: Lift the chest, don't collapse forward

movements.name: Attitude devant
movements.description: The leg lifts in front with a soft, rounded knee, heel pressing forward.
cues: Knee and foot at similar heights

movements.name: Développé devant
movements.description: Through retiré, the leg unfolds forward to 90° or higher.
cues: Pull the heel forward as you unfold

movements.name: Développé à la seconde
movements.description: The leg unfolds to the side at hip height or higher while the torso stays perfectly vertical.
cues: Don't let the working hip rise

movements.name: Développé derrière
movements.description: Through retiré the leg extends behind into arabesque or attitude line.
cues: Lift the leg as the chest lifts

movements.name: Grand rond de jambe en l'air
movements.description: The leg sweeps at 90° from front to side to back (or reverse) in one continuous arc.
cues: Rotation increases as the leg passes to the back

movements.name: Temps lié
movements.description: A flowing transfer of weight through demi-plié and tendu that links positions, travelling forward and sideways.

movements.name: Promenade
movements.english: Slow turn on a flat foot
movements.description: Holding a pose such as attitude or arabesque, the dancer pivots slowly in a full circle by small heel shifts.
cues: Spot slowly, or keep the head with the body

movements.name: Croisé devant
movements.description: A body direction: angled to the corner with the downstage leg extended to the front — legs appear crossed.
cues: Hips and shoulders to the corner

movements.name: Effacé devant
movements.description: A body direction angled to the corner with the upstage leg in front, giving an open, 'shaded' line.
cues: Head looks over the raised arm

movements.name: Écarté
movements.description: Facing the corner, the leg extends to the side towards the other corner, the body inclining away.
cues: Body tilts away from the leg
Look up to the raised hand or down

movements.name: À la quatrième devant
movements.description: Facing the audience squarely, the leg extends straight in front.

movements.name: Renversé
movements.description: A turning movement in which the upper body bends back deeply from attitude, finishing in a pas de bourrée.
cues: Bend from the upper back only
Let the head finish the turn

movements.name: Balance in retiré
movements.description: A sustained balance on demi-pointe in retiré with arms in fifth.
cues: Stack hips over the ball of the foot

movements.name: Pirouette en dehors
movements.description: From fourth position the dancer rises to retiré and turns away from the supporting leg.
cues: Arrive in retiré and relevé together
Spot: head last to leave, first to arrive

movements.name: Double pirouette en dehors
movements.description: Two rotations in retiré from a fourth-position preparation.

movements.name: Pirouette en dedans
movements.description: A turn towards the supporting leg; the working leg opens and then draws into retiré.
cues: Use the working leg to start the turn
Stay on top of the supporting leg

movements.name: Piqué tour en dedans
movements.description: The dancer steps directly onto a straight leg on demi-pointe and turns in retiré, travelling on a line.
cues: Step out on a straight leg

movements.name: Chaînés
movements.description: A series of quick half-turns on demi-pointe, feet close together in first, travelling in a line or circle.
cues: Spot quickly, keep the knees pulled up

movements.name: Soutenu en tournant
movements.description: Drawing the working leg into sous-sus, the dancer turns a full revolution on both feet.
cues: Change feet as you complete the turn

movements.name: Fouetté rond de jambe en tournant
movements.description: The famous series of turns: the working leg whips out to the side and in to retiré, sustaining continuous rotation.
cues: Open the leg front before whipping it to the side
Hips stay square during the whip

movements.name: Grande pirouette à la seconde
movements.english: Turning with the leg in second
movements.description: Multiple turns holding the leg at 90° to the side, often with hops of the supporting heel — a male virtuoso step.

movements.name: Pirouette en attitude
movements.description: A pirouette with the working leg held in attitude derrière and the arm raised in fifth.
cues: Lift the knee higher than the foot

movements.name: Pirouette en arabesque
movements.description: Turning on demi-pointe with the leg extended behind in arabesque.
cues: Commit to the line before the turn

movements.name: Piqué en dehors
movements.description: A piqué onto a straight leg turning outward, the working foot flicking to retiré behind.
cues: Step and turn away from the supporting leg

movements.name: Tour en l'air
movements.description: From fifth position, a vertical jump with one or two full rotations, landing in fifth — a classical male step.
cues: Arms close to fifth or first instantly
Change the feet in the air

movements.name: Coupé jeté en tournant
movements.description: A travelling turning jump in a circle: a coupé step, a half turn and a throw of the leg into a split jeté.
cues: Turn on the step, not in the air

movements.name: Sauté
movements.description: A simple jump from two feet, keeping the position (first, second or fifth) in the air.
cues: Push through the floor with the toes

movements.name: Changement de pieds
movements.description: A jump from fifth in which the feet change in the air, landing with the other foot in front.
cues: Show both legs straight in the air

movements.name: Échappé sauté
movements.description: From fifth the legs 'escape' to second (or fourth) in the air and land apart, then close back.
cues: Open in the air, not on the floor
Close to fifth with the other foot front

movements.name: Assemblé
movements.description: The working leg brushes out, the dancer springs, and both legs join together in the air before landing in fifth.
cues: Join the legs at the top of the jump
Land in fifth at the same time on both feet

movements.name: Petit jeté
movements.description: A brushing jump from one foot to the other, landing with the working foot wrapped behind the ankle.
cues: Land on the opposite foot in fondu

movements.name: Glissade
movements.description: A gliding travelling step: the foot slides out, the body passes over, and the other foot closes in fifth.
cues: Both feet point in the air briefly

movements.name: Pas de chat
movements.description: A sideways jump where each leg lifts in succession to retiré, like a cat leaping, landing in fifth.
cues: First leg up, second follows quickly

movements.name: Sissonne simple
movements.description: A jump from two feet landing on one, with the other foot arriving sur le cou-de-pied.
cues: Land on one foot in plié

movements.name: Sissonne fermée
movements.description: A jump from two feet that opens the legs in the air and closes quickly into fifth, travelling.
cues: Travel in the direction of the front foot

movements.name: Sissonne ouverte
movements.description: Spring from two feet and land on one, holding the other leg open in the air — arabesque, attitude or à la seconde.
cues: Show the open leg at the top
Land with the leg still up

movements.name: Entrechat quatre
movements.description: A vertical jump in which the legs open and close, beating twice before landing in fifth with the same foot in front.
cues: Beat with the thighs, not the feet

movements.name: Entrechat six
movements.description: Three crossings of the legs in the air, landing with the opposite foot in front.

movements.name: Royale
movements.description: A changement with a beat: the legs beat once in front before changing.

movements.name: Brisé
movements.description: A small travelling beaten assemblé: the working leg brushes, beats against the other in the air, and lands in fifth.
cues: Beat at the height of the jump

movements.name: Ballonné
movements.description: A jump on one foot while the other leg extends and folds back to cou-de-pied, like a bouncing ball.
cues: Extend and fold at the same time

movements.name: Ballotté
movements.description: A rocking jump: the legs alternately unfold to the front and back while the body sways like a boat.
cues: Rock the body, not the hips

movements.name: Emboîté
movements.description: Small alternating jumps from foot to foot, the working leg lifting to cou-de-pied or attitude front each time.
cues: Change feet at the top of each jump

movements.name: Pas de basque
movements.description: A three-count travelling step: the leg describes a half circle, the weight springs across and closes.
cues: Rond the leg low on the floor
Arms open and close with the step

movements.name: Temps levé en arabesque
movements.description: A hop on one leg holding the arabesque line.

movements.name: Soubresaut
movements.description: A jump from fifth to fifth without changing feet, travelling forward, the body slightly arched.

movements.name: Gargouillade
movements.description: A pas de chat in which each leg performs a small rond de jambe in the air while rising.
cues: Rond with the first leg as it lifts
Second leg follows the same path

movements.name: Grand jeté
movements.description: A big leap from one foot to the other with the legs in a full split in the air.
cues: Throw the front leg, push off the back
Split at the top of the jump

movements.name: Saut de chat
movements.description: A leaping split in which the front leg passes through développé (or a bent knee) before stretching.
cues: Développé the front leg through the air

movements.name: Jeté entrelacé
movements.description: A turning leap: the dancer throws one leg to the front, turns in the air and lands in arabesque on the same leg.
cues: Turn the hips at the top

movements.name: Cabriole
movements.description: The extended leg is beaten by the underneath leg in the air, front or back, before landing.
cues: Beat the lower leg up to it
Land on the beating leg in fondu

movements.name: Grande sissonne
movements.description: A big sissonne from two feet travelling forward into a high arabesque.
cues: Land on the front leg in arabesque

movements.name: Saut de basque
movements.description: A travelling turning jump: the dancer turns in the air with one leg in retiré and the other extended.
cues: Step and throw the leg to the side

movements.name: Grand pas de chat
movements.description: A big travelling leap with the front leg in a high développé and the back leg in attitude.

movements.name: Saut de biche
movements.description: A leap where the front leg is bent (attitude) while the back leg stretches long.

movements.name: Grand assemblé
movements.description: A large travelling assemblé with a grand battement, joining the legs in the air.

movements.name: Fouetté sauté
movements.description: The leg is thrown forward, the body whips around in the air and lands in arabesque facing the other way.
cues: Battement front, then turn the hips
Keep the leg at height through the whip

movements.name: Sauté en arabesque
movements.description: A big hop in arabesque, travelling forward with a sustained line.
cues: Hold the arabesque in the air

movements.name: Temps levé en attitude
movements.description: A hop holding the leg in attitude derrière, arm raised.

movements.name: Pas de bourrée dessous
movements.description: Three small steps — back, side, front — on demi-pointe, changing feet: the punctuation of ballet.

movements.name: Pas de bourrée couru
movements.description: Tiny, rapid steps on demi-pointe or pointe with the feet in a tight fifth, gliding across the floor.
cues: Steps so small they are invisible

movements.name: Balancé
movements.description: A three-count waltz step swaying from side to side: step, ball change, step.

movements.name: Chassé
movements.description: A sliding step where one foot 'chases' the other out of its position, often with a little spring.
cues: Second foot catches the first in the air

movements.name: Tombé
movements.description: The dancer 'falls' onto the working leg in demi-plié, transferring weight forward, back or sideways.
cues: Let the weight fall, but with control

movements.name: Pas failli
movements.description: A sissonne whose back leg passes through first to the front — a quick, breathy preparation for big jumps.
cues: Sweep the back leg through first

movements.name: Coupé
movements.description: A small step that 'cuts' one foot away by replacing it with the other — the link before jetés and turns.

movements.name: Piqué arabesque
movements.description: Stepping directly onto a straight leg on demi-pointe or pointe, lifting into arabesque.
cues: Step far onto a straight leg
Back leg arrives with the step

movements.name: Pas couru
movements.description: A small running preparation (often three steps) gathering momentum for a big jump.
cues: Run on the balls of the feet

movements.name: Glissade précipitée
movements.description: A quick, low glissade used to link into big allegro.
cues: Spring straight into the next step

movements.name: Sous-sus sur les pointes
movements.description: A spring onto full pointe drawing both feet into a tight fifth under the body.
cues: Pull up out of the shoes

movements.name: Relevé sur les pointes
movements.description: From demi-plié a quick spring onto full pointe, ankles fully over the box.
cues: Over the box, not behind it

movements.name: Échappé relevé
movements.description: From fifth demi-plié the feet spring apart to second on pointe, then close.
cues: Pull the feet in as you close

movements.name: Retiré sur la pointe
movements.description: Rising onto pointe on one leg while the working foot draws to the knee — the shape of a pointe pirouette.

movements.name: Piqué sur la pointe
movements.description: Stepping directly onto the tip of a straight leg, the other foot lifting to cou-de-pied or retiré.

movements.name: Bourrée sur les pointes
movements.description: Rapid shimmering steps on pointe — the swan's glide across the lake.
cues: Tiny steps from the knees down

movements.name: Fouettés sur les pointes
movements.description: The 32 fouettés of Swan Lake's Black Swan: whipping turns on pointe.

movements.name: Pas de cheval
movements.description: The working foot paws the floor like a horse: through cou-de-pied to a small extended point.

movements.name: Détourné
movements.description: A half or full pivot in sous-sus on pointe, changing the front foot.
cues: Finish with the other foot front
